name: A Personal Winter
source:
On a snowy night, a boy heads to an abandoned movie theater with his senpai, Ryo. Together, they set fire to their school for the sheer thrill of it.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/5366060/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
在一个大雪纷飞的夜晚，少年与学长凉（Ryo）一同前往一座废弃电影院。纯粹为了寻求刺激的两人，联手放火烧掉了自己的学校。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/5366060/]Steam[/url]]
